3: You have granted him the desire of his soul, and have not withheld from him the request of his lips. Pause.
4: For you have prevented him with blessings of goodness: you have set upon his head a crown of precious stone.
5: He asked life of you, and you gave him length of days for ever and ever.
6: His glory is great in your salvation: you will crown him with glory and majesty.
7: For you will give him a blessing for ever and ever: you will gladden him with joy with your countenance.
8: For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Highest he shall not be moved.
9: Let your hand be found by all your enemies: let your right hand find all that hate you.
10: You shall make them as a fiery oven at the time of your presence: the Lord shall trouble them in his anger, and fire shall devour them.
11: You shall destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from [among] the sons of men.
12: For they intended evils against you; they imagined a device which they shall by no means be able to perform.
13: For you shall make them [turn their] back in your latter end, you will prepare their face.
14: Be you exalted, O Lord, in your strength: we will sing and praise your mighty acts.
